Founding Engineer

Campus Connect

A student collaboration platform focused on project matching, team formation, and lightweight portfolio building for university communities.

Problem

Students often have ideas and interest but struggle to find collaborators with the right skills, availability, and project goals.

Campus Connect addressed that gap with a profile-driven experience that made team discovery faster and more intentional.

Contribution

I scoped the MVP, implemented the core profile and discovery flows, and created the content structure used across onboarding and project posting.

I focused on simple flows, strong defaults, and copy that made the product immediately understandable.

  • Implemented profile creation, project cards, and matching-oriented filters
  • Defined the reusable component patterns that kept the interface coherent
  • Worked across UX decisions, frontend delivery, and backend integration

Why It Matters

This project demonstrates product ownership as much as implementation. The emphasis was not only shipping features, but clarifying what users needed to do next and why the platform was useful.
